program_alignment.central_question: Is R6J low-i posterior error mainly caused by non-nested greedy bound selection, or does it persist after enforcing a monotone valid-bound envelope?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: cheapest prerequisite before a new content-based/nested region implementation
program_alignment.downstream_gate: implement a richer partition/region family only if monotone envelope selection cannot deliver uniform low-i accuracy

research_basis.source: Rollon and Dechter, New Mini-Bucket Partitioning Heuristics for Bounding the Probability of Evidence, AAAI 2010
research_basis.role: partition refinement governs monotonic bound improvement and partition strategy affects likelihood-bound quality
research_basis.project_finding: R6J independent greedy runs have 3 evidence and 14 marginal monotonicity violations

model.greedy_branch: independent scope-greedy mini-bucket result at each i
model.envelope_branch: for every total or clamped evidence query at i_j, take the minimum valid upper bound over all registered i<=i_j, then normalize the two clamped envelopes as a pseudo-marginal
model.guarantee: each evidence envelope is a valid nonincreasing upper bound; normalized clamped ratios remain diagnostics, not posterior bounds
model.not_claimed: the envelope is not a new nested mini-bucket partition algorithm

matrix.conditions: same 4 observations × 2 p × 2 representations × 2 orders × 4 i values as R6J
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; no correction, LER, threshold, or fault-tolerance samples

question.H1: the envelope removes every total-evidence monotonicity violation
question.H2: the envelope reduces marginal-error monotonicity violations and improves low-i useful-accuracy coverage
question.H3: even after envelope selection, no representation/order branch is uniformly useful on all eight conditions at i<=14
question.falsification: any envelope above its corresponding greedy bound, below exact evidence, or exact-ceiling mismatch rejects the implementation

analysis.comparison: matched condition/representation/order/i rows; report improvements and regressions without post-hoc deletion
analysis.stop_rule: if H3 holds, route next work to genuinely richer content/region construction; otherwise validate the successful envelope on paper-L2 bounds before correction
analysis.claim_boundary: Method diagnostic on primitive exact evidence only; no nested-algorithm, paper-L2 accuracy, decoder, LER, threshold, scaling, or fault-tolerance claim.

acceptance_items.item: query-level clamped bound provenance and 256 matched rows

acceptance_items.evidence: 3 to 0 evidence violations; 14 to 13 marginal-error violations; useful low-i rows remain 20 and uniform branches remain 0

acceptance_items.item: report, roadmap, metadata, and durable state

outcome.decision: Do not promote mini-bucket to correction or LER sampling; next compare a genuinely content-aware region/partition construction on the same exact cohort.
